columns.validationmsg: "Please Enter Valid Value For Pack Units"
columns.name: packunits

table.retrieve:
SELECT   
	item.customicode,
	alternatecustomicode=advpurdetail.alternatecustomicode,
	item.name, 
	currlistrow = 0,
	totalstock=0.0000, 
	stock=0.0000,
	itemtotalval=space(30),
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
	icode=dbo.advpurdetail.icode,
	batch=dbo.advpurdetail.batch,
	expiry=dbo.advpurdetail.expiry,
	gcode=dbo.advpurdetail.gcode,
	packqty=dbo.advpurdetail.packqty,   
	looseqty=dbo.advpurdetail.looseqty,
	bonusqty=dbo.advpurdetail.bonusqty,
	foreignprice=dbo.advpurdetail.foreignprice,
	packunits=dbo.advpurdetail.packunits,      
	basicpackunits=dbo.item.packunits,
	measureunitcode=dbo.advpurdetail.measureunitcode,
	MeasureQty=(SELECT M.MeasureQty FROM DBO.MeasuringUnit M WHERE M.measureunitcode = advpurdetail.measureunitcode),
	measureunitrate=dbo.advpurdetail.measureunitrate,
	retailprice=dbo.advpurdetail.retailprice,
	purprice=dbo.advpurdetail.purprice,   
	purprice2=dbo.advpurdetail.purprice2,   
	purprice3=dbo.advpurdetail.purprice3,   
	purprice4=dbo.advpurdetail.purprice4,   
	CDiscPerc=dbo.advpurdetail.CDiscPerc,   
	CDiscPerc2=dbo.advpurdetail.CDiscPerc2,   
	CDiscPerc3=dbo.advpurdetail.CDiscPerc3,   
	itemflatdisc=dbo.advpurdetail.itemflatdisc,
	itemflatdiscafterdiscperc=dbo.advpurdetail.itemflatdiscafterdiscperc,
	itemflatdisc2=dbo.advpurdetail.itemflatdisc2,
	discperc2=dbo.advpurdetail.discperc2,	
	valuedisconitem=dbo.advpurdetail.valuedisconitem,
	advpurinvcode=dbo.advpurdetail.advpurinvcode,
	avgprice=dbo.advpurdetail.avgprice,
	dbo.advpurdetail.IDENTITYCOL,
	newavgprice=dbo.advpurdetail.newavgprice,
	currstock=dbo.advpurdetail.currstock,
	purutn=dbo.advpurdetail.purutn ,
	UnitIncomeTaxRuleCode=UnitIncomeTaxRuleCode,
	UnitIncomeTax=UnitIncomeTax,
	PercIncomeTaxRuleCode=PercIncomeTaxRuleCode,
	PercIncomeTax=PercIncomeTax,
	UnitAdditionalTaxRuleCode=UnitAdditionalTaxRuleCode,
	UnitAdditionalTax=UnitAdditionalTax,
	PercAdditionalTaxRuleCode=PercAdditionalTaxRuleCode,
	PercAdditionalTax=PercAdditionalTax,
	UnitExtraTaxRuleCode=UnitExtraTaxRuleCode,
	UnitExtraTax=UnitExtraTax,
	PercExtraTaxRuleCode=PercExtraTaxRuleCode,
	PercExtraTax=PercExtraTax,
	UnitCustomDutyRuleCode=UnitCustomDutyRuleCode,
	UnitCustomDuty=UnitCustomDuty,
	PercCustomDutyRuleCode=PercCustomDutyRuleCode,
	PercCustomDuty=PercCustomDuty,
	unittaxrulecode=dbo.advpurdetail.unittaxrulecode,
	gsttypecode=dbo.advpurdetail.gsttypecode,
	gstrulecode=dbo.advpurdetail.gstrulecode,
	gstperc=dbo.advpurdetail.gstperc,
	unitsalestax=dbo.advpurdetail.unitsalestax,
	saleprice=dbo.advpurdetail.saleprice,
	rate=dbo.advpurdetail.rate,
	NetRate=dbo.advpurdetail.NetRate,
	itemdescription=dbo.advpurdetail.itemdescription,
	salepriceforitem=dbo.advpurdetail.salepriceforitem,
	recentpurprice=CASE WHEN (SELECT P.Posted FROM PurLedger P WHERE P.PurInvCode=:ai_PurInvCode) = 'Y' THEN dbo.advpurdetail.recentpurprice ELSE item.recentpurprice END ,
	discountedsaleprice=dbo.advpurdetail.discountedsaleprice,
	discountedpurprice= (ISNULL(dbo.advpurdetail.purprice, 0) + ISNULL(dbo.advpurdetail.purprice2, 0) + ISNULL(dbo.advpurdetail.purprice3, 0) + ISNULL(dbo.advpurdetail.purprice4, 0)) * (1 - dbo.advpurdetail.discperc * 0.01),
	discperc=dbo.advpurdetail.discperc
FROM 
	dbo.advpurdetail , 
	dbo.item
WHERE 
	dbo.advpurdetail.advpurinvcode = :ai_PurInvCode AND
	dbo.advpurdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode
ORDER BY
	dbo.advpurdetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_bonusvalue
objects.expression: sum( (if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty *  c_totalprice ), 0) ) for all)

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: 'Bonus Value For GST % = ' + trim(string(c_bonusvalue))

objects.name: c_sumpackqty
objects.expression: SUM( packqty FOR ALL)

objects.name: c_sumbonusqty
objects.expression: sum(bonusqty for all)

objects.name: d_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum((c_totalprice - itemflatdisc) * packqty * (1 - (discperc * 0.01)) * (1 - (cdiscperc * 0.01)) * (1 - (cdiscperc2 * 0.01)) * (1 - (cdiscperc3 * 0.01)) - (packqty * itemflatdiscafterdiscperc) for all)

objects.name: d_detaildwforeigntotal
objects.expression: sum(((foreignprice * looseqty) + (foreignprice * packqty)) * (1- (discperc * 0.01)) * (1- (cdiscperc * 0.01)) * (1- (cdiscperc2 * 0.01)) * (1- (cdiscperc3 * 0.01)) for all)

objects.name: c_totitemflatdiscvalue
objects.expression: Round(sum( packqty * itemflatdisc for all),2)

objects.name: c_totitemflatdisc2
objects.expression: Round(sum( packqty * itemflatdisc2 for all),2)

objects.name: c_total_finalitemval
objects.expression: sum(c_finalitemval for all)

objects.name: c_sumgstval
objects.expression: sum(if(gstperc=0, 0, if(gsttypecode=1, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_total, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ), if(gsttypecode=2, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), Round((packqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 5) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), Round((bonusqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 5), 0) ), (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), Round((packqty * ( purprice + purprice2 + purprice3 + purprice4 )), 5) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), Round((bonusqty * ( purprice + purprice2 + purprice3 + purprice4 )), 5), 0) ) )) * gstperc *  0.01) for all)

objects.name: c_totvalforinvgst
objects.expression: sum( if(gsttypecode=1, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_total, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ),  (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), Round((packqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 5) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), Round((bonusqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 5), 0) )  ) for all)

objects.name: c_tot_discount_after_saletax
objects.expression: sum(c_discount_after_saletax for all)

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: sum(c_totitemvalue_b4_discperc2 for all)

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: sum( c_itemtotal_afterdiscperc2 for all)

objects.name: c_sumtaxval
objects.expression: Sum(unitsalestax * ( if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=3, bonusqty, 0) + if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=2, packqty, 0) ) for all)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum( unitcustomduty * ( if( unitcustomdutyrulecode IN (1, 3), bonusqty, 0) + if( unitcustomdutyrulecode IN (1,2), packqty, 0) ) + (( if(perccustomdutyrulecode = 4, 0, if(perccustomdutyrulecode = 3, (bonusqty * c_totalprice), if(perccustomdutyrulecode = 2, c_total, c_total + (bonusqty * c_totalprice)))) ) * perccustomduty * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: compute_5
objects.expression: sum( unitextratax * ( if( unitextrataxrulecode IN (1, 3), bonusqty, 0) + if( unitextrataxrulecode IN (1,2), packqty, 0) ) + (( if(percextrataxrulecode = 4, 0, if(percextrataxrulecode = 3, (bonusqty * c_totalprice), if(percextrataxrulecode = 2, c_total, c_total + (bonusqty * c_totalprice)))) ) * percextratax * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: sum( unitadditionaltax * ( if( unitadditionaltaxrulecode IN (1, 3), bonusqty, 0) + if( unitadditionaltaxrulecode IN (1,2), packqty, 0) ) + (( if(percadditionaltaxrulecode = 4, 0, if(percadditionaltaxrulecode = 3, (bonusqty * c_totalprice), if(percadditionaltaxrulecode = 2, c_total, c_total + (bonusqty * c_totalprice)))) ) * percadditionaltax * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: sum( unitincometax * ( if( unitincometaxrulecode IN (1, 3), bonusqty, 0) + if( unitincometaxrulecode IN (1,2), packqty, 0) ) + (( if(percincometaxrulecode = 4, 0, if(percincometaxrulecode = 3, (bonusqty * c_totalprice), if(percincometaxrulecode = 2, c_total, c_total + (bonusqty * c_totalprice)))) ) * percincometax * 0.01) for all)

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: SUM(c_totitemvalue_b4_discperc2 * discperc2 * 0.01 for all)

objects.name: c_totalitemdiscval
objects.expression: Round( SUM( (purprice + purprice2 + purprice3 + purprice4 - itemflatdisc) * discperc * 0.01 * packqty for all), 2)

objects.name: compute_9
objects.expression: Round( SUM( (purprice + purprice2 + purprice3 + purprice4 - itemflatdisc) * (1 - (discperc * 0.01)) * cdiscperc * 0.01 * packqty for all), 2)

objects.name: compute_10
objects.expression: Round( SUM( (purprice + purprice2 + purprice3 + purprice4 - itemflatdisc) * (1 - (discperc * 0.01)) * (1 - (cdiscperc * 0.01)) * cdiscperc2 * 0.01 * packqty for all), 2)

objects.name: compute_11
objects.expression: Round( SUM( (purprice + purprice2 + purprice3 + purprice4 - itemflatdisc) * (1 - (discperc * 0.01)) * (1 - (cdiscperc * 0.01)) * (1 - (cdiscperc2 * 0.01)) * cdiscperc3 * 0.01 * packqty for all), 2)

objects.name: c_total
objects.expression: (c_totalprice - itemflatdisc) * packqty * (1 - (discperc * 0.01)) * (1 - (cdiscperc * 0.01)) * (1 - (cdiscperc2 * 0.01)) * (1 - (cdiscperc3 * 0.01)) - (packqty * itemflatdiscafterdiscperc)

objects.name: c_serialno
objects.expression: getRow()

objects.name: c_taxval
objects.expression: unitsalestax * ( if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=3, bonusqty, 0) + if( unittaxrulecode = 1 or unittaxrulecode=2, packqty, 0) )

objects.name: c_gstval
objects.expression: if(gstperc=0, 0, if(gsttypecode=1, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), c_total, 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), (bonusqty * purprice), 0) ), if(gsttypecode=2, (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), Round((packqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 5) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), Round((bonusqty * retailprice) / (1+ (gstperc * 0.01) ), 5), 0) ), (if(gstrulecode in (1,2), Round((packqty * ( purprice + purprice2 + purprice3 + purprice4 )), 5) , 0) + if(gstrulecode in (1,3), Round((bonusqty * ( purprice + purprice2 + purprice3 + purprice4 )), 5), 0) ) )) * gstperc *  0.01)

objects.name: c_finalitemval
objects.expression: c_itemtotal_afterdiscperc2 -  valuedisconitem

objects.name: c_foreigntotal
objects.expression: ((foreignprice * looseqty) + (foreignprice * packqty)) * (1- (discperc * 0.01)) * (1- (cdiscperc * 0.01)) * (1- (cdiscperc2 * 0.01)) * (1- (cdiscperc3 * 0.01))

objects.name: c_totalprice
objects.expression: purprice + purprice2 + purprice3 + purprice4

objects.name: c_itemtotal_afterdiscperc2
objects.expression: c_totitemvalue_b4_discperc2 * (1 - discperc2 * 0.01)

objects.name: c_incometaxvalue
objects.expression: unitincometax * ( if( unitincometaxrulecode IN (1, 3), bonusqty, 0) + if( unitincometaxrulecode IN (1,2), packqty, 0) ) + (( if(percincometaxrulecode = 4, 0, if(percincometaxrulecode = 3, (bonusqty * c_totalprice), if(percincometaxrulecode = 2, c_total, c_total + (bonusqty * c_totalprice)))) ) * percincometax * 0.01)

objects.name: c_additionaltaxvalue
objects.expression: unitadditionaltax * ( if( unitadditionaltaxrulecode IN (1, 3), bonusqty, 0) + if( unitadditionaltaxrulecode IN (1,2), packqty, 0) ) + (( if(percadditionaltaxrulecode = 4, 0, if(percadditionaltaxrulecode = 3, (bonusqty * c_totalprice), if(percadditionaltaxrulecode = 2, c_total, c_total + (bonusqty * c_totalprice)))) ) * percadditionaltax * 0.01)

objects.name: c_totitemvalue_b4_discperc2
objects.expression: c_total  + c_incometaxvalue + c_additionaltaxvalue + c_extrataxvalue + c_customdutyvalue + c_taxval  +  c_gstval - (packqty * itemflatdisc2)

objects.name: c_extrataxvalue
objects.expression: unitextratax * ( if( unitextrataxrulecode IN (1, 3), bonusqty, 0) + if( unitextrataxrulecode IN (1,2), packqty, 0) ) + (( if(percextrataxrulecode = 4, 0, if(percextrataxrulecode = 3, (bonusqty * c_totalprice), if(percextrataxrulecode = 2, c_total, c_total + (bonusqty * c_totalprice)))) ) * percextratax * 0.01)

objects.name: c_customdutyvalue
objects.expression: unitcustomduty * ( if( unitcustomdutyrulecode IN (1, 3), bonusqty, 0) + if( unitcustomdutyrulecode IN (1,2), packqty, 0) ) + (( if(perccustomdutyrulecode = 4, 0, if(perccustomdutyrulecode = 3, (bonusqty * c_totalprice), if(perccustomdutyrulecode = 2, c_total, c_total + (bonusqty * c_totalprice)))) ) * perccustomduty * 0.01)

objects.name: c_margin
objects.expression: Round ( (salepriceforitem - Round( (netrate  / if(packunits =0,1, packunits )) * basicpackunits,5)) / if(salepriceforitem=0,1, salepriceforitem ) * 100 , 2 )

objects.name: c_markup
objects.expression: Round ( ((salepriceforitem - Round( (netrate  / if(packunits =0,1, packunits )) * basicpackunits,5)) / if(Round( (netrate  / if(packunits =0,1, packunits )) * basicpackunits,5)= 0, 1, Round( (netrate  / if(packunits =0,1, packunits )) * basicpackunits,5)) ) * 100 , 2 )

objects.name: c_netrate
objects.expression: Round( (netrate  / if(packunits =0,1, packunits )) * basicpackunits,5)

objects.name: c_discount_after_saletax
objects.expression: ( c_totitemvalue_b4_discperc2 * discperc2 * 0.01) + ( packqty * itemflatdisc2 ) +  valuedisconitem
